nav.logoutConfirmDesc: This clears the saved site connection and access token ({{url}}). The dashboard, wallet, API keys and usage logs will no longer read site data.
nav.siteTokenInvalidDesc: Your access token was rejected by the site. Please sign in again.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Manage site tokens: view, copy, enable/disable and delete.
apiKeys.notConnectedDesc: Use "Site Import" on the Providers page to connect a new-api site, then your keys show up here.
apiKeys.empty: No keys on the site yet
apiKeys.emptyDesc: You can create one via "Site Import" on the Providers page.
apiKeys.confirmRemoveDesc: Requests using this key will fail immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.importNoModels: The site returned no available models to import
apiKeys.importNoSiteBase: Site URL not found; check the site connection in Profile first
apiKeys.createDesc: Create a new token on the site: pick a group, name it, and it appears in the list right away.
apiKeys.createGroupHint: Ratio affects billing: actual cost = model price × group ratio.
apiKeys.createNoGroups: No groups available; refresh and try again.
apiKeys.createKeyNameHint: Keep the zmate- prefix so you can identify and revoke it in the site console.
apiKeys.copyMaskedDesc: The site did not return the plaintext key (likely new-api key masking). Copy the full key from the site console instead.

usageLogs.title: Usage Logs
usageLogs.description: Site call records: models, token usage and cost.
usageLogs.notConnectedDesc: Use "Site Import" on the Providers page to connect a new-api site, then your logs show up here.
usageLogs.empty: No logs in the selected range

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.description: View site balance, total usage and API request count, and redeem codes.
wallet.redeemDesc: Enter a redemption code; the quota goes straight into your site balance.
wallet.shopDesc: No code? Buy one from the card shop, then redeem above.
wallet.notConnectedDesc: Use "Site Import" on the Providers page to connect a new-api site, then your wallet shows up here.
wallet.affiliateDesc: Earn rewards when users sign up with your referral link. Transfer accumulated rewards to your balance anytime.
wallet.invitedEmptyDesc: Users who signed up with your referral link will appear here.

site.title: Site Import
site.description: Connect a new-api site: pick an existing key, auto-create one, or fill protocol and URL manually.
site.existingDesc: Pick directly from the token list of your site.
site.createDesc: Pick a group and the key is created and used automatically.
site.customDesc: Fill protocol, URL and key manually. Works with any relay.
site.pickEmpty: No tokens on the site yet. Try "I don't have a key" instead.
site.keyNoSecret: This token did not return its secret and cannot be auto-filled.
site.groupHint: Ratio affects billing: actual cost = model price × group ratio.
site.keyNameHint: Keep the zmate- prefix so you can identify and revoke it in the site console.
site.createKeyNoSecret: Key created but its secret was not returned; paste it manually on the next page or copy it from the site console.
site.saveConnectionFailed: Site connected, but saving the connection failed; the dashboard cannot show balance and usage.
site.siteFetchModelsFailed: Failed to fetch site models; pull with the key or add models manually.
site.manualModels: Add models manually (comma or space separated)
site.doneDesc: {{providerId}} injected with {{count}} models. Test connectivity from the list.
site.usingStoredConnection: Using the site connection saved in "Site Login": {{url}}
site.storedConnectFailed: The saved site connection failed verification. Please sign in and bind again.
site.reasoningLevels: Reasoning levels (low to high, all selected by default)

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Manage ZCode custom model providers: add, inject, enable/disable and delete, with per-model reasoning levels.
providers.emptyDesc: Click "Add Provider" and paste your relay API key to inject one.

wizard.protocolDesc: Matches ZCode's native options; determines request format and URL suffix rules.
wizard.baseUrlDesc: Anthropic protocol auto-fills without /v1; OpenAI protocols append /v1.
wizard.apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste the API key created on your relay
wizard.apiKeyDesc: The key is written to local ZCode config only and never sent anywhere else.
wizard.noModels: No models returned; check the URL and key
wizard.reasoningLevelsDesc: Click to toggle a level; selected levels appear in ZCode's model picker. All selected by default.
wizard.reasoningMapDesc: Advanced: CEL expression mapping a level into the request body. Leave empty to auto-generate per protocol.

providers.confirmRemoveDesc: Removes the provider and all its model rules from ZCode config. A backup is created first.
providers.connectivityAuthFailed: Server reachable, but the key was rejected (HTTP {{status}})
providers.zcodeRunningHint: ZCode is running: injection normally takes effect immediately. If models don't appear, restart ZCode from Maintenance.
providers.keyKeepHint: Key configured — leave blank to keep it
providers.noKeyToTest: This provider has no API key; configure one to test
providers.noModelToTest: No models to test for this provider
providers.modelTestHint: Testing sends a real ping request to the model
providers.streamTestDesc: Sends one real streaming inference request to {{name}} and records each stage.
providers.streamTestNote: First-token latency is written back to the card badge. The first test includes connection setup, so it's usually slightly slower than real chats.
providers.streamTestIdleHint: Click the button below to start the connectivity test

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.description: Manage ZCode's MCP entries (~/.zcode/cli/config.json) directly in ZMate.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.pathCopiedDesc: The config file path has been copied to the clipboard.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Import, remove, back up and restore ZCode user-level skills (~/.zcode/skills) in ZMate.
skills.pathCopiedDesc: The path has been copied to the clipboard.
skills.confirmRemove: Remove this skill? A backup is created automatically.
skills.confirmDeleteBackup: Delete this backup? This cannot be undone.

customInstructions.title: Instructions
customInstructions.description: Manage ZCode's global instructions — only the managed block in ~/.zcode/AGENTS.md; project-level AGENTS files are untouched.
customInstructions.currentDescription: Only the ZMate managed block is shown; your other rules are never overwritten.
customInstructions.editorDescription: Edit from a template, then apply — only the ZMate block in the global AGENTS.md is updated.
customInstructions.editorPlaceholder: Edit the content to write into the global managed block
customInstructions.historyDescription: Recent local applications, with quick rollback.
customInstructions.globalScopeHint: Only manages the ZMate block in ~/.zcode/AGENTS.md
customInstructions.clearedManagedContent: The ZMate block will be cleared.
customInstructions.clearConfirmDescription: Only removes the ZMate managed block from ~/.zcode/AGENTS.md; your other rules are kept.
customInstructions.templatesLoadFailed: Failed to load templates; using built-ins
customInstructions.previewDescription: Only the ZMate block in ~/.zcode/AGENTS.md will be updated.
customInstructions.applySuccessDesc: The ZMate block was written to ~/.zcode/AGENTS.md.
customInstructions.clearSuccessDesc: The ZMate block was removed from the global AGENTS.md.
customInstructions.rollbackSuccess: Rolled back to the selected version
customInstructions.rollbackSuccessDesc: The current ZMate block was replaced with the selected history version.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Browse local ZCode sessions: list, stats and transcripts. Session Transfer can export sessions to a zip or import them back (auto backup before writing).
sessions.emptyDesc: Try another keyword, or start a new session in ZCode.
sessions.dbMissingDesc: Make sure ZCode is installed and session data exists under ~/.zcode.

detail.selectHint: Select a session to view its transcript and stats
detail.noMessages: No messages to show for this session

transfer.title: Session Transfer
transfer.desc: Export sessions to a zip for backup or moving between machines, or import sessions from a zip into local ZCode.
transfer.exportCardDesc: Pick sessions and pack them into a zip for backup or migration to another device.
transfer.importCardDesc: Pick a previously exported zip and restore its sessions into local ZCode.
transfer.exportDesc: All sessions selected by default (archived included); search to filter. The export includes list entries, full transcripts and usage stats.
transfer.importDesc: Import writes sessions into local ZCode. The original databases are backed up automatically first.
transfer.targetZmateChatHint: Sessions will be imported into ~/ZMate chat in your home folder (created automatically).
transfer.importWarning: Import writes into the local ZCode session databases; the originals are backed up to zmate/backups/session-transfer/ first.

maintenance.installDesc: Download and install the ZCode desktop app from the official site at zcode.z.ai.
maintenance.downloadConfirmDesc: The official site zcode.z.ai will open in your browser to download the ZCode desktop app.
maintenance.installOpenFailed: Could not open the download page
maintenance.diagnoseDesc: Check the ZCode data directory, config file validity and running state.
maintenance.proxyDesc: Route all network traffic of the ZCode desktop app and its child processes through a local proxy.
maintenance.proxyInvalidPort: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535
maintenance.proxyExternalHint: Current proxy is a custom address {{url}}; applying will overwrite it
maintenance.proxyHint: Written to the ZCode desktop settings v2/setting.json (original file is backed up); takes effect after restarting ZCode.
maintenance.proxySaved: Saved to {{path}}. Restart ZCode to apply.
maintenance.directDesc: Use a direct IP when the domain is unreachable.
maintenance.directHint: Click Switch to test the primary domain and two direct IPs, then pick any reachable entry to switch; select the primary domain again to restore. Changes are written to panel settings and provider config (auto backup).
maintenance.directDialogDesc: Tests the primary domain and two direct IPs. Select a reachable entry, then click Switch to apply.
maintenance.directAllFailed: Please enable a proxy or port forwarding. If it still fails, contact the site admin on WeChat: swj_0227
maintenance.directSwitched: Site entry switched to {{origin}}: site connection updated and {{count}} provider endpoints rewritten.
maintenance.directRestored: Domain is back; site entry restored to {{origin}} ({{count}} provider endpoints rewritten).
maintenance.cleanDesc: Delete config backups, skill backups and instruction history created by ZMate. ZCode data is untouched.
maintenance.restartZcodeDesc: Gracefully quit and relaunch the ZCode desktop app to make config changes take effect.
maintenance.restartConfirmDesc: ZCode will quit gracefully and relaunch. Ongoing sessions may be interrupted.
maintenance.cleanResult: Cleaned: {{provider}} provider backups, {{skill}} skill backups, {{instruction}} instruction histories

settings.title: Settings
settings.checkZcodeRunningDesc: Detect whether ZCode is running before writing to its config, guarding against write-back overwrites.
settings.accentColorDesc: Primary color for buttons, selections and highlights.
settings.upToDateDesc: You are on the latest version.
settings.updateCheckFailedDesc: Check your network connection and try again.

update.title: Update available
update.installBlocked: This app cannot self-update from its current location. Reopen ZMate from a real install path and try again.
update.installBlockedReadOnlyLocation: ZMate is running from a read-only location and cannot self-update. Move ZMate to Applications or a local folder, reopen it there, then update.
update.installBlockedAppTranslocation: ZMate is running from a temporary read-only mount on macOS and cannot self-update. Move ZMate to Applications or a local folder, then reopen it there.
update.installPromptDesc: ZMate is running from a temporary read-only location on macOS; later updates will fail. Move ZMate into Applications first, then reopen it from Launchpad.

siteLogin.title: Site Login
siteLogin.description: Connect a new-api site to provide shared credentials for the dashboard, wallet, API keys and usage logs.
siteLogin.dialogDesc: Sign in and bind the site to continue the import; the access token stays on this machine.
siteLogin.tokenSet: Set · stored locally only, never displayed
siteLogin.passwordSet: Signed in · Stored locally only, never displayed
siteLogin.tokenPlaceholder: Paste the system access token generated on the site
siteLogin.tokenHelp: Generate a system access token in the new-api site admin "Settings" page, then paste it here.
siteLogin.userIdHelp: Required when the site enforces the New-Api-User check (see "Personal Settings" in the site console); leave empty for older sites.
siteLogin.userIdInvalid: User ID must be a positive integer, or leave it empty
siteLogin.passwordHelp: Sign in with your site account: a system access token is generated on the site and stored locally (each sign-in regenerates it). Not available when the site enables CAPTCHA or two-factor auth — use the access token method instead.
siteLogin.disconnectDesc: This clears the saved site URL and access token ({{url}}). The dashboard, wallet, API keys and usage logs will no longer read site data; injected provider configs are unaffected.
siteLogin.httpWarning: You are using a plain HTTP address; the token could be intercepted. HTTPS is recommended.
siteLogin.emptyHint: Once connected, the site URL and token status will appear here.
siteLogin.usageHint: After connecting: dashboard balance & usage · wallet · API keys · usage logs · one-click key creation in the import wizard. The token is stored only in local settings.json and never sent back to the UI.
